evidence.quote:
A man didn't complete the first
Earth-Mars flight ever made, smash his ship to hell, and then just walk
away from it.
evidence.paraphrase: The protagonist has traveled to Mars on the first Earth-Mars flight.
The mission plan specifies staggered crews and contingency conditions for the long interplanetary journey.

evidence.quote:
You had thought our planet lifeless; it was an
error. We live underground, John Love. That is why you did not see us,
or surface indications of our existence.
evidence.paraphrase: A supposedly dead Mars is revealed to hold an underground living civilization.

evidence.quote:
A group of us speak your
language, because for eleven days we have been studying your brain and
analyzing your thought-patterns.
evidence.paraphrase: The aliens explain they learned English by analyzing the human's brain over eleven days.

evidence.quote: "Damn you! God damn you, what are you going to do to me?"
evidence.paraphrase: Johnny reacts with fear and anger to his alien captors.

evidence.quote:
Space-flight requires but a relative minimum of those things, Earthman.
Required most is psychological and philosophical conditioning.
evidence.paraphrase: The aliens argue that spaceflight demands psychological, not just physical, preparation.

evidence.quote:
We wish to give you data to take back to your Earth which will banish
disease for you--_all_ disease. Data which will give you spacecraft that
match our own in technical perfection.
evidence.paraphrase: The aliens offer advanced scientific data to Earth.

evidence.quote:
You sound too damned much like a
politician.
evidence.paraphrase: Johnny is suspicious of the aliens' overly generous offer.

evidence.quote: "Tell me _why_."
evidence.paraphrase: Johnny demands an explanation for the aliens' motives as a condition of belief.

evidence.quote:
It was the Earth that men had
intended, rather than that which they had built.
evidence.paraphrase: A dream shows an idealized version of Earth as humanity intended it.

evidence.quote: Skeletons, reaching upward to a puffy, leaden sky.
evidence.paraphrase: A vision depicts Earth reduced to devastation and death.

evidence.quote:
A psibeam unit is
unaccounted for, and despite our protective screening, the Earthman was
visibly disturbed in his sleep.
evidence.paraphrase: The Martians describe a stolen psibeam device affecting the human's mind despite their screening.

evidence.quote:
With this instrument, they have succeeded in
taking one of Nature's more subtle phenomenon--psychokinesis--and
amplifying its energies nearly a million-fold. Those stepped-up energies
can then be projected in a tight or fanned beam at will.
evidence.paraphrase: The psibeam device amplifies psychokinetic energy and projects it as a beam.

evidence.quote:
They can make a man 'dream,' as you did--or they can destroy him
outright, depending on which of the 'psi' factors, ESP or PK, is given
dominance during projection.
evidence.paraphrase: The device can induce dreams or kill depending on which psi factor dominates.

evidence.quote:
Their weapon is knowledge, but
the potentialities of that knowledge must be understood by a people
before it can be effectively used to destroy them.
evidence.paraphrase: The invaders use gifted knowledge as a weapon that destroys advanced civilizations.

evidence.quote:
Until there was no trust left on all the planet.

There were the wars, then.
evidence.paraphrase: The gifted knowledge led to distrust and planet-wide war on Mars.

evidence.quote:
After we destroyed ourselves, they sank
their infectious, hollow roots into our planet.
evidence.paraphrase: The Martian civilization destroyed itself and was taken over by the invaders.

evidence.quote:
Once your blast-off ogee had
carried you beyond the curvature of their horizon and brought you over
us, our psibeam was effective and theirs were not.
evidence.paraphrase: The psibeam's effectiveness depends on line of sight over the planetary curvature.

evidence.quote:
If your friends return
successfully to your planet with that 'gift'--then--
evidence.paraphrase: The other crews carrying the alien 'gift' home would doom Earth.

evidence.quote: I can figure 'em," he said. "I know blast-off schedules, speeds. I know the works!
evidence.paraphrase: Johnny volunteers his mission knowledge to help destroy the returning crews.

evidence.quote:
There had been too many giant steps, too fast. He had seen this thing in
the faces of men before, but never so nakedly.
evidence.paraphrase: The General senses that humanity has advanced too fast and must retreat.

evidence.quote:
Then Johnny Love was on his feet again, and the sand clutched at his
heavy boots as though to keep him from leaving Ferris and the ship
evidence.paraphrase: Johnny surviving alone on the Martian surface after the crash.

evidence.quote:
Perhaps at this point you should be informed that your ship is
completely repaired, and ready for your return to Earth whenever you
desire.
evidence.paraphrase: The aliens have fully repaired Johnny's wrecked ship in days.
